newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Cement in synthetic glass venture.
newsitem.headline: Siam Cement in synthetic glass venture.

text.p: The Siam Cement Plc said on Wednesday it teamed up with Mitsubishi Rayon Co Ltd in a three billion baht ($120 million) joint venture plant to produce a raw material for synthetic glass.

Siam Cement said in a statement that the venture, Thai MMA Co Ltd, will start production from 1999 and is capable of producing up to 70,000 tonnes of methyl methacrylate (MMA), a major material in synthetic glass, a year.
Siam Cement's wholly owned unit, Cementhai Chemicals Co, and Mitsubishi Rayon will each hold a 45 percent stake in the project to be located at Map Ta Phut in eastern Rayong province.
The remaining shareholdings will be hold by several other Thai and Japanese shareholders.
